# Claude Agent SDK for Crystal

> An unofficial Anthropic Agent SDK for Crystal that provides a programmatic interface to the Claude Code CLI. Enables building autonomous AI agents that can execute commands, edit files, stream events, manage sessions, and perform complex multi-step workflows.
>
> Developed against Claude Code CLI **v2.1.220**, with SDK-surface parity through Python `0.2.152` / TypeScript `0.3.263`. Forward-compatible: features that require newer CLI versions are gracefully no-op or surface a clear error on older CLIs.

This SDK communicates with the Claude Code CLI via JSON over stdin/stdout using `--output-format stream-json` and `--input-format stream-json` flags. This is the same architecture used by the official Claude Code Agent SDKs. The CLI handles authentication, the agent loop, built-in tools, and API communication.

## Key Features

- One-shot queries and interactive sessions
- V2 streaming interface with send/receive patterns
- Type-safe JSON Schema builder (Crystal's answer to Zod)
- Structured outputs with JSON schema validation
- Dynamic controls (`set_permission_mode`, `set_model`, `get_mcp_status`, `reconnect_mcp_server`, `toggle_mcp_server`, `stop_task`, `apply_flag_settings`, `enable_remote_control`, `set_proactive`, `generate_session_title`, `get_context_usage`, `reload_plugins`, `prompt_suggestion`, `set_mcp_servers`, `enable_mcp_channel`)
- Typed `ContextUsageResponse` with per-category token usage and autocompact thresholds
- Server initialization metadata via `get_server_info`
- Convenience helpers for supported agents/commands from initialization metadata
- Custom tool definitions with MCP server support (stdio, HTTP, SSE)
- In-process SDK MCP servers with control protocol (same architecture as official SDKs)
- Preset types for system prompt and tools (ToolsPreset, SystemPromptPreset)
- `SystemPromptPreset` with `exclude_dynamic_sections` for cache-friendly prompts; `SystemPromptFile` for loading the prompt from disk
- Skills support (`skills: "all"` or a named list) with automatic `setting_sources` defaults
- Task budgets (`task_budget`) and fixed session titles (`title`)
- Subagent definitions with rich fields (`disallowed_tools`, `memory`, `initial_prompt`, `max_turns`, `background`, `effort`, `permission_mode`, per-agent `mcp_servers`)
- Rich event messages (`InitMessage`, task lifecycle messages including `TaskUpdatedMessage` with `TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES`, `RateLimitEvent`, compact boundary, `ApiRetryMessage`, `MemoryRecallMessage`, `StatusMessage`, `MirrorErrorMessage`, unknown-message fallback)
- Assistant-message enrichment: `tool_use_meta` sidecar (array of per-block entries with `id`, `display_name`, `server_display_name`, `icon_url`, plus `tool_use_meta_for` lookup), structured `stop_details` (`StopDetails`: category/explanation/fallback_credit_token) + `refusal?` for refusal detection, typed `origin` (`MessageOrigin` with `kind` + `human?`/`task_notification?`) on `ResultMessage`
- Full hook support (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, PreCompact, Notification, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, TeammateIdle, TaskCompleted, ConfigChange)
- Permission management with callbacks and control-protocol propagation; permission context exposes `tool_use_id`, `agent_id`, and `blocked_path`
- Permission modes: `default`, `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `bypassPermissions`, `auto`, `dontAsk`
- Session management (resume, fork, continue, resume_session_at, delete)
- Session history (`list_sessions`, `get_session_info`, `get_session_messages` with `include_system_messages`)
- Session forks and subagent transcripts (`fork_session`, `list_subagents`, `get_subagent_messages`, `delete_session`); `SessionMessage#parent_agent_id` for depth-2+ agent trees
- Session metadata mutation (`rename_session`, `tag_session`)
- **SessionStore** external transcript mirror: `InMemorySessionStore`, `FileSessionStore`, custom adapters; options `session_store` / `session_store_flush` (`batched`|`eager`) / `load_timeout_ms`; live CLI `--session-mirror` via `TranscriptMirrorBatcher` (frames not yielded to consumers); `MirrorErrorMessage` on append failure; resume materialization into temp `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (subkeys, redacted credentials, `.claude.json`); `import_session_to_store` and `*_from_store` / `*_via_store` helpers; `SessionStoreConformance.run(store)` contract suite
- Model ID convenience constants (`ClaudeAgent::Models::*`) — free-form `String` model field remains unrestricted (no `claude-mythos-preview`)
- Tool output helpers: `BashToolOutput`, `AgentToolCompletedOutput` / `AgentToolQueuedOutput`, `SkillToolOutput`, `NotebookEditOutput`, `ReadMcpResourceDirOutput`, `ReadMcpResourceOutput`, `WebSearchToolOutput`, `BuiltinTools` name constants
- User/assistant envelope enrichment: `tool_use_meta` array; `tool_result_meta` **array** (`id` / `non_execution_kind` / `user_feedback`, `tool_result_meta_for`); `is_meta` / `is_synthetic` / `file_attachments`; assistant `timestamp` / `aborted`
- Typed `ModelUsage` on results (`canonical_model`, `provider`, token/cost fields); lifecycle system messages (`command_lifecycle`, `background_tasks_changed`, `model_fallback`, …)
- Client controls: `interrupt(cancel_queued:)` → `InterruptReceipt`, `reinitialize`, `respond_to_permission`, `seed_read_state`, MCP `request_timeout_ms`, background-task-aware `each_response`
- Hooks include `MessageDisplay`, `DirectoryAdded` (plus PreToolUse … ConfigChange)
- Transcript controls (`should_query: false` appends a user message without triggering a turn)
- Prompt suggestions and async message controls (`prompt_suggestions`, `PromptSuggestionMessage`, `settings`, `cancel_async_message`)
- MCP elicitation callback surface (`on_elicitation`, Elicitation hooks, `ElicitationCompleteMessage`)
- File checkpointing and rewind (file state via `rewind_files`, transcript via `rewind_conversation`) — incompatible with `session_store`
- Sandbox configuration with credential protection and `strictAllowlist`; `workflow_size_guideline`
- Debug: `debug` / `debug_file`; subprocess env always includes `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION`
- Managed settings (`managed_settings`) emitted as `--managed-settings <json>` (policy tier below IT-controlled sources)
- Subagent text streaming (`forward_subagent_text`, via the initialize control request)
- Plugin configs (`PluginConfig`; `skip_mcp_discovery: true` emits `--plugin-dir-no-mcp` instead of `--plugin-dir`)
- Extended thinking support (`thinking` with `adaptive`/`enabled`/`disabled` modes, `effort` tiers including `xhigh`, legacy `max_thinking_tokens`)
- Pre-warming the CLI subprocess with `ClaudeAgent.startup`
- Automatic W3C trace context propagation (`TRACEPARENT`/`TRACESTATE`)
- Fine-grained partial streaming when `include_partial_messages` is enabled
- `ResultMessage.terminal_reason` and `errors` accessors; `InitMessage#memory_paths`; `MCPServerStatus#capabilities`
- Graceful handling of unknown content block types (forward-compatible)
- CLI capability probe: auto-detects which option flags the installed Claude Code CLI understands and silently drops forward-compatible SDK-only flags (`--task-budget`, `--thinking`, `--system-prompt-file`) on older CLIs
- Typed `ClaudeAgent::UnsupportedOptionError` surfaced when the CLI rejects an option flag, with the offending flag name and resolved CLI path
- `options.title` is applied as a session-file mutation (no CLI flag); `SystemPromptPreset#exclude_dynamic_sections` flows through the `initialize` control request as `excludeDynamicSections`
- Optional live E2E coverage for parity-critical flows

- [src/claude_agent/types/control_messages.cr](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/src/claude_agent/types/control_messages.cr): Control protocol types (interrupt receipts, seed_read_state, SDK MCP, etc.)

## Schema Builder API

The Schema module provides type-safe JSON schema generation (Crystal's answer to Zod):

```crystal
# Basic types
Schema.string(description, min_length:, max_length:, pattern:, format:)
Schema.integer(description, minimum:, maximum:)
Schema.number(description, minimum:, maximum:)  # floats
Schema.boolean(description)

# Complex types
Schema.array(items_schema, description, min_items:, max_items:)
Schema.object(properties_hash, required:, description:, additional_properties:)
Schema.enum(["value1", "value2"], description)  # string literals

# Combinators
Schema.optional(schema)  # union with null
Schema.union(schema1, schema2, ...)  # oneOf

# Usage with tools
tool = ClaudeAgent.tool(
  name: "my_tool",
  description: "Tool description",
  schema: Schema.object({
    "param" => Schema.string("Parameter description"),
  }, required: ["param"])
) { |args| ToolResult.text("result") }

# Usage with structured outputs
options = AgentOptions.new(
  output_format: OutputFormat.json_schema(schema, name: "Name", description: "...")
)
```

## Tools and MCP

- [src/claude_agent/tools/sdk_tool.cr](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/src/claude_agent/tools/sdk_tool.cr): Custom tool definition helpers
- [src/claude_agent/tools/sdk_mcp_server.cr](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/src/claude_agent/tools/sdk_mcp_server.cr): MCP server implementation

### SDK MCP Server Workflow

Create in-process custom tools (same architecture as official Claude Code SDKs):

```crystal
# 1. Define tools
tool = ClaudeAgent.tool(name: "name", description: "desc", schema: schema) { |args| ToolResult.text("result") }

# 2. Create SDK MCP server
server = ClaudeAgent.create_sdk_mcp_server(name: "server-name", tools: [tool])

# 3. Configure agent
mcp_servers = {} of String => ClaudeAgent::MCPServerConfig
mcp_servers["server-name"] = server

options = AgentOptions.new(
  mcp_servers: mcp_servers,
  allowed_tools: ["mcp__server-name__tool-name"]  # Pattern: mcp__<server>__<tool>
)

# 4. Query - tools execute in your Crystal process
ClaudeAgent.query("prompt", options) { |msg| ... }
```

### External MCP Servers

Connect to external MCP servers:

```crystal
mcp_servers = {} of String => ClaudeAgent::MCPServerConfig
mcp_servers["name"] = ExternalMCPServerConfig.stdio("command", ["args"])  # Local process
mcp_servers["name"] = ExternalMCPServerConfig.http("https://url")         # HTTP
mcp_servers["name"] = ExternalMCPServerConfig.sse("https://url")          # SSE streaming
```

## Hooks and Permissions

- [src/claude_agent/hooks.cr](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/src/claude_agent/hooks.cr): Hook system with all events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, PreCompact, Notification, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, TeammateIdle, TaskCompleted, ConfigChange)
- [src/claude_agent/permissions.cr](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/src/claude_agent/permissions.cr): Permission callback system

### Hook Events

| Event | Description | Event-Specific Fields |
|-------|-------------|----------------------|
| PreToolUse | Before tool execution (can block/modify) | `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id` |
| PostToolUse | After successful tool execution | `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`, `tool_result`/`tool_response` |
| PostToolUseFailure | After tool execution failure | `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`, `error`, `is_interrupt` |
| PermissionRequest | When permission dialog appears | `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`, `permission_suggestions` |
| Elicitation | MCP server requests user input | `mcp_server_name`, `elicitation_message`, `elicitation_mode`, `elicitation_url`, `elicitation_id`, `requested_schema` |
| ElicitationResult | User responded to an MCP elicitation | `mcp_server_name`, `elicitation_action`, `elicitation_content`, `elicitation_id` |
| PreCompact | Before conversation compaction | `trigger`, `custom_instructions` |
| Notification | Agent status notifications | `notification_message`, `notification_title`, `notification_type` |
| UserPromptSubmit | When user submits prompt | `user_prompt` |
| Stop | When agent stops | `stop_hook_active` |
| SubagentStart | Subagent initialization | `agent_id`, `agent_type` |
| SubagentStop | Subagent completion | `agent_id`, `agent_type`, `agent_transcript_path`, `stop_hook_active` |
| SessionStart | Session initialization | `source` |
| SessionEnd | Session termination | `session_end_reason` |
| TeammateIdle | A background agent is idle and available | `agent_id`, `agent_type` |
| TaskCompleted | Background task finished | `task_id`, `task_status`, `task_summary`, `tool_use_id` |
| ConfigChange | Settings / permissions changed mid-session | `config_change_source`, `config_change_diff` |

`HookMatcher` also supports an optional `timeout` value in seconds for control-protocol hook registrations.

### Compact Boundary Detection

When the CLI compacts a session, it emits a `CompactBoundaryMessage`:

```crystal
when ClaudeAgent::CompactBoundaryMessage
  puts "Compacted: #{message.compact_metadata.trigger}"
  puts "Pre-tokens: #{message.compact_metadata.pre_tokens}"
end
```

### Tool Use ID Access

Tool use IDs are available on `ToolUseBlock`:

```crystal
when ClaudeAgent::AssistantMessage
  message.content.each do |block|
    if block.is_a?(ClaudeAgent::ToolUseBlock)
      puts "Tool: #{block.name}, ID: #{block.id}"
    end
  end
end
```

### Interrupt/Cancellation

```crystal
client.interrupt  # Signal CLI to stop current operation
```

### Thinking Content Access

```crystal
when ClaudeAgent::AssistantMessage
  message.content.each do |block|
    case block
    when ClaudeAgent::ThinkingBlock
      puts block.thinking
    when ClaudeAgent::RedactedThinkingBlock
      puts "Redacted: #{block.signature}"
    end
  end
end
```

### HookInput Fields

Common context fields (available on all hook events):
- `session_id` - Current session identifier
- `transcript_path` - Path to the JSONL transcript file
- `cwd` - Current working directory
- `permission_mode` - Permission mode (`default`, `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `bypassPermissions`, `auto`, `dontAsk`)
- `hook_event_name` - Hook event name (e.g., "PreToolUse", "PreCompact", "Stop", "TaskCompleted")

Event-specific fields:
- `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id` - Tool-related fields
- `tool_result`, `tool_response` - Tool execution results
- `error`, `is_interrupt` - PostToolUseFailure fields
- `user_prompt` - For UserPromptSubmit
- `notification_message`, `notification_title`, `notification_type` - For Notification hook
- `trigger`, `custom_instructions` - For PreCompact hook
- `stop_hook_active` - For Stop/SubagentStop hooks
- `agent_id`, `agent_type`, `agent_transcript_path` - For subagent and TeammateIdle hooks
- `source` - For SessionStart
- `session_end_reason` - For SessionEnd
- `permission_suggestions` - For PermissionRequest
- `mcp_server_name`, `elicitation_message`, `elicitation_mode`, `elicitation_url`, `elicitation_id`, `requested_schema`, `elicitation_action`, `elicitation_content` - For Elicitation / ElicitationResult hooks
- `task_id`, `task_status`, `task_summary` - For TaskCompleted
- `config_change_source`, `config_change_diff` - For ConfigChange
- `prompt_id` - Stable identifier for the current prompt (correlate hooks with OpenTelemetry prompt-level spans; CLI v2.1.196+)

`PermissionContext` (passed to `can_use_tool` callbacks) additionally carries `tool_use_id`, `agent_id`, and `blocked_path` for richer permission decisions.

- [examples/session-stores/](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/tree/main/examples/session-stores): File demo + `SessionStoreConformance`; Redis/Postgres reference adapters (optional shards)

## Optional

- [spec/](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/tree/main/spec): Test files
- [shard.yml](https://github.com/amscotti/claude-agent-cr/blob/main/shard.yml): Crystal shard configuration

## Optional Live E2E

Optional parity-critical live checks can be run with:

```bash
CLAUDE_AGENT_RUN_E2E=1 crystal spec spec/e2e_spec.cr
```

These live E2E specs cover:

- Server info and dynamic controls
- Session history
- Hook-based tool input overrides
- Rich task events
- Structured outputs
- Typed init-message metadata

### Version Notes

- **0.10.0**: Parity with Python `0.2.152` / TS `0.3.263` SDK surface (CLI 2.1.220-tested). **Behavior**: `query()` raises `ResultError` after yielding error results; `query()` honors `can_use_tool`/SDK servers via `AgentClient`; skill names validated; resume materialize partitions `.meta.json` sidecars + seeds settings. **New**: `ConversationResetMessage`, `UserMessage#origin` (+ tolerant parse), `resume_drops_turn`, subagent parent-id recovery, result/task/hook/init scalar fields (see README changelog).
- **0.9.0**: Parity release aligned with Claude Code CLI **v2.1.220** (Python `0.2.128` / TS `0.3.220`). **Breaking**: typed `ResultMessage#model_usage` / `permission_denials`. **Messages**: `ModelUsage` (+ `canonical_model`/`provider`), lifecycle system messages, user `is_meta`/`file_attachments`, **`tool_result_meta` as array** (CLI wire shape; `tool_result_meta_for`), tool-output helpers, usage-limit prefixes. **Client**: interrupt receipts (`still_queued`/`cancelled`), `reinitialize`, `respond_to_permission`, `seed_read_state`, MCP timeouts, background-aware `each_response`. **SessionStore**: `InMemorySessionStore`, `FileSessionStore`, `SessionStoreConformance`, via-store helpers, live `--session-mirror` + `TranscriptMirrorBatcher`, resume materialize (+ auth copy / subkeys). Redis/Postgres reference adapters under `examples/session-stores/`. **Tool helpers**: Bash/Agent/Skill/Notebook/MCP resource dir/WebSearch parsers + `BuiltinTools`. **Options/CLI**: sandbox `strictAllowlist`, `workflow_size_guideline`, `debug`/`debug_file`, `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION` env, `tool_config` preview format, shadow warning, equals-form argv. **Hooks**: `MessageDisplay`, `DirectoryAdded`. **Models**: `ClaudeAgent::Models::*` (no mythos-preview). Examples `43_models`, `44_session_store`, `session-stores/file_demo`. Live-verified against CLI 2.1.220.
- **0.8.0**: Parity release aligned with Claude Code CLI **v2.1.201** (Python `0.2.110` / TS `0.3.201`). **New messages**: `TaskUpdatedMessage` + `TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES` set + `#terminal?` (background tasks can finish *only* via `system/task_updated`; prevents active-task tracking hangs). `AssistantMessage#tool_use_meta` sidecar — array of `ToolUseMeta` entries (`id`, `display_name`, `server_display_name?`, `icon_url?`) with `#tool_use_meta_for(id)` lookup — for display-friendly tool-call labels. `AssistantMessage#stop_details` (typed `StopDetails`: `category`, `explanation`, `fallback_credit_token`) + `#refusal?` for refusal detection. `ResultMessage#origin` (typed `MessageOrigin`: `kind` + variant fields, `human?`/`task_notification?` predicates) to distinguish user-prompted results from task followups. **New control request**: `rewind_conversation` (`AgentClient#rewind_conversation(user_message_id, dry_run:)`) truncates the transcript with a durable resume anchor. **New options**: `managed_settings` (emitted as `--managed-settings <json>`, a real flag hidden from `--help`; policy tier below IT-controlled sources), `forward_subagent_text` (via the initialize control request), `sandbox.credentials` (`SandboxCredentialsSettings` with `SandboxCredentialFile` {path, mode: deny} and `SandboxCredentialEnvVar` {name, mode: deny|mask, inject_hosts} entries), `PluginConfig` — `skip_mcp_discovery: true` emits `--plugin-dir-no-mcp` instead of `--plugin-dir`. **Other**: `prompt_id` on `HookInput` (OpenTelemetry correlation), `RATE_LIMIT_TYPES` constant (incl. `seven_day_overage_included`). All wire shapes verified against the official TS SDK runtime and CLI binary. New example `examples/42_fruit_template.cr`.
- **0.7.0**: Feature release aligned with Claude Code CLI **v2.1.158**. Added `display` option to `ThinkingConfig` adaptive/enabled configurations (`ThinkingConfigAdaptive` and `ThinkingConfigEnabled`) and mapped it to the `--thinking-display` CLI flag. Implemented `HookEventMessage` system message and parser to enable hook event streaming when `include_hook_events` is enabled. Added `updated_tool_output` to `HookSpecificOutput` and mapped it to `"updatedToolOutput"` in the control protocol to allow post-tool hooks to override any tool's stdout/stderr before it reaches the model. Added `decision_reason`, `title`, `display_name`, and `description` to both `ControlPermissionRequest` and `PermissionContext` to support context-enriched permission prompts in custom callbacks. Implemented `DeferredToolUse` and `deferred_tool_use` on `ResultMessage` to support `"defer"` hook decisions and deferred tool execution. Implemented `ServerToolUseBlock` and `ServerToolResultBlock` to parse and expose server-side tool calls and advisor results. Expanded `SandboxNetworkSettings` to include `allowedDomains`, `deniedDomains`, `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and `allowMachLookup`. Added example `examples/41_adaptive_thinking_display.cr`.
- **0.6.0**: Hardening release with breaking changes. **Removed**: `ClaudeAgent::PermissionDeniedError` (never raised; deletion is safe). **Renamed**: `MCPToolAnnotations` fields to MCP-spec `*Hint` keys (`read_only_hint?`/`destructive_hint?`/`open_world_hint?`) plus new `idempotent_hint?` and `title`. **Behavioral**: `QueryIterator#next` re-raises errors instead of silently stopping; `AgentOptions#skills` rejects unrecognized strings with `ConfigurationError`; `resume_session_at` without `resume` raises `ConfigurationError`; `skills: []` is a true no-op; `skills: "all"` omitted from initialize wire; `InitMessage#memory_paths` / `MemoryRecallMessage#memory_paths` are `Hash(String, String)` (namespace ➔ path); `opts.agents` no longer forwarded via `--agents` argv; `--setting-sources` always `=`-joined; dead `CLIClient#send_sdk_init` removed. Key fixes: `CLIClient#stop` gains a terminate/kill cascade (no more hangs on unresponsive CLIs); unknown `control_request` subtypes reply with an error instead of silently hanging the CLI; `claude --help` probe has a 5s timeout; user hook callbacks are wrapped in a rescue so buggy hooks can't crash the reader fiber; capability probe no longer strips flags (false-negative on current CLI silently disabled safety caps like `task_budget`); `opts.agents` no longer double-delivered via argv; `--setting-sources` always uses `=`-joined form; `resume_session_at` without `resume` raises `ConfigurationError`; `skills: []` is a true no-op; `skills: "all"` no longer emitted on the wire; `skills: "invalid"` raises `ConfigurationError` instead of silently no-oping. New typed fields on `AssistantMessageBody` (id, usage, stop_reason, stop_sequence, container, context_management) and `InitMessage`/`ServerInfo` (tools, skills, mcp_servers, plugins, cwd, model, permission_mode, fast_mode_state, claude_code_version). `QueryIterator#next` re-raises errors instead of silently stopping. `MCPToolAnnotations` uses MCP-spec `*Hint` keys plus `idempotentHint`. `ClaudeAgent::PermissionDeniedError` removed (was never raised). `AgentClient.stop` closes message channel before stopping CLI. New `ControlUnknownRequest` fallback struct.
- **0.5.1**: Audit release validating every 0.5.0 option and message field against the live Claude Code CLI (v2.1.114) and the Python SDK. Bug fixes: `options.title` no longer forwarded as `--title` (title is a session-file mutation); `SystemPromptPreset#exclude_dynamic_sections` now flows through the `initialize` control request as `excludeDynamicSections`; `permission_prompt_tool_name` emits the correct `--permission-prompt-tool` CLI flag; `enable_file_checkpointing` sets the `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING=true` environment variable instead of a non-existent CLI flag; outgoing user messages use camelCase `shouldQuery`; `InitMessage#memory_paths` and `MemoryRecallMessage#memory_paths` are now correctly `Hash(String, String)` matching the CLI's actual payload shape. New `ResultMessage` fields: `api_error_status`, `model_usage`, `permission_denials`, `fast_mode_state`. `CLIClient` runs `claude --help` once per `cli_path` and drops forward-compatible SDK-only flags (`--task-budget`, `--thinking`, `--system-prompt-file`) on older CLIs. New `ClaudeAgent::UnsupportedOptionError`. New `AgentOptions#probe_cli_capabilities` (default `true`) toggles the probe.
- **0.5.0**: `skills` option, `SystemPromptFile`, `SystemPromptPreset#exclude_dynamic_sections`, `task_budget`, `title`; `PermissionMode::Auto` and `DontAsk`; `Effort::Xhigh` tier (default for Claude Opus 4.7); corrected thinking CLI mapping (`--thinking adaptive|disabled`); expanded `AgentDefinition` fields; runtime MCP/plugin controls (`get_context_usage`, `reload_plugins`, `prompt_suggestion`, `set_mcp_servers`, `enable_mcp_channel`); session helpers (`fork_session`, `delete_session`, `list_subagents`, `get_subagent_messages`); `should_query: false` and `include_system_messages`; `ClaudeAgent.startup` pre-warming; new hook events (`TeammateIdle`, `TaskCompleted`, `ConfigChange`); new typed messages (`ApiRetryMessage`, `MemoryRecallMessage`, `StatusMessage`, `MirrorErrorMessage`); W3C trace context propagation; `ResultMessage.terminal_reason`/`errors`, `InitMessage#memory_paths`, `MCPServerStatus#capabilities`; `PermissionContext` gains `tool_use_id`, `agent_id`, `blocked_path`; eight new examples (33-40)
- **0.4.0**: Session history and mutation APIs, dynamic controls (model, permissions, MCP, flag settings, remote control, proactive mode, session titles), server info, richer task/init/rate-limit/prompt-suggestion/elicitation/unknown message typing, thinking/effort options, `ResultMessage.stop_reason`, fine-grained partial streaming for `include_partial_messages`, prompt suggestions, async message controls, MCP elicitation support, hook/permission propagation parity, hook matcher timeouts, and optional live E2E coverage
- **0.3.0**: Full hook parity, CompactBoundaryMessage for session compaction detection, all event-specific fields, PermissionRequest hook event
- **0.2.0**: Added UnknownBlock, Notification hook, resume_session_at, PreCompact hook fields, fixed hook callback dispatch
- Developed against Claude Code CLI v2.1.220
